Tired of asking "Anyone want to play?" and hearing nothing?

You post in a Facebook group. Your message gets buried. The evening slips away.

Or you show up to open play and the games are full. When you do get in, the level is off. Nobody's really the level they say they are.

  • You stand on the sidelines while your free night disappears.
  • You drive across town, then wait for a court.
  • You feel awkward asking strangers, "Can I join?"
  • Your group needs a fourth, and nobody answers.

You don't need more hassle. You just want to play.

Meet Bingle: your shortcut to a game you'll love

Bingle is a Victoria-made app that finds local players who fit your level, your schedule, and your style. Want to improve faster? Find a coach on Bingle and get lessons. Coaches and players both have reviews, so you know who you're meeting.

  1. Tell us your level and when you're free.
  2. Browse nearby players, read their reviews, match, chat, and set the game. "See you at 6?"
  3. After you play, your built-in AI coach asks what went well and what didn't. Your answers sharpen your profile, so your next match fits even better.
  4. Want to level up? Find a coach and get lessons. Every coach has reviews.

You do the playing. We do the hard part.

What to work on
✕Backhand drive when pulled wide

Great session. Your dinks stayed low and patient all night, and your drops gave your partner time to get to the net.

In game two, most of your lost points came from backhand drives that popped up when you were pulled wide. Try a soft reset to the middle there, and do 10 cross-court resets before your next game.

What you get when you play with Bingle

Play with people at your level

Set your rating and how you like to play, from relaxed to competitive. Bingle shows you players who fit, so every game feels fair and fun.

Find a partner who fits your game

After each match, the AI coach asks what went well and what didn't. Your answers grow your profile, so you meet partners whose strengths cover your weak spots.

Get a game on the nights you're free

Pick your open times, like Tuesday and Thursday evenings. Chat first and read reviews from other players. You choose who to match with, and you can report or block anyone.

Learn from coaches you can trust

Find a coach near you and get lessons to sharpen your game. Coaches have reviews from real players, so you can pick with confidence.

Questions? We've got you.

Is Bingle free?

Yes. Matching and chatting are free during the beta.

What is the tournament?

Everyone who joins the beta gets free entry to Bingle's first-ever tournament, with cash prizes. We'll share the date and details with beta members.

Can I find a coach on Bingle?

Yes. Browse coaches near you, read their reviews, and get lessons to improve your game. Players have reviews too.

What does the AI coach do?

After each match, it asks what shots went well and what didn't. Your answers build your profile, so Bingle can suggest partners whose strengths cover your weak spots.

What if I'm new, or not sure of my level?

Pick the level that feels closest. You can change it any time. Plenty of players here want a relaxed game.

Is it safe to meet new people?

You pick who you match with and chat first. You can report or block anyone, and we suggest meeting at public courts.
